description: One image job's current state: a SINGLE, IMMEDIATE read that waits for nothing. WHEN: only for one job's raw fields now (cost, refund, why it failed). It is not how you wait (`wait_for_generation` is) or show an image (`generate_image` already opened the card; `show_generation` brings back an earlier one). Do not poll it. `status` is `queued`, `processing`, `succeeded` (`url` is the finished file) or `failed` (terminal: `error.message` says why). OUTPUT: tell the user the media URL and one line about it, not raw JSON or job ids.
name: get_image
title: Get an AI image job
